description.value: Sen Zushi is an authentic Japanese restaurant on Fort Street in Victoria, operated by a Japanese owner and chefs who blend traditional and contemporary cuisine. The menu spans nigiri, sashimi, sushi rolls, tempura, udon noodles, and premium sake, with a dedicated happy hour program and rotating special menu. A long-standing local favourite, it offers both a sushi bar and full dine-in experience alongside takeout.
